picks.headline: Can Interactive 3D Improve Digital Textbooks Without Making Reading More Complicated?
picks.excerpt: Digital textbook publishers can now use AI text-to-3D tools to turn lesson descriptions into interactive 3D models, but the piece argues they should deploy the technology selectively where it clarifies spatial or internal structures that flat images cannot.
picks.rationale: Fresh, actionable angle for educational publishers: AI text-to-3D as a selective tool for spatial concepts - a new production use-case not covered anywhere in the books history.
